title: Hruday spectral-window and inverse-energy certificate
selection_reason: AT1 repairs the moment/domain obligation in AQ itself. Its review permits bounded spectral functionals while explicitly excluding pole inference. Modern primary-source advice proposes exact one-sided moment certificates and equal-moment controls.
target: Certify one finite energy-window mass and an inverse-energy quadratic-form interval in the same AQ state, then test whether this moment information can identify an energy atom.
model: Actual AQ numerical-cap centered Wilson spectral measure from AT1 and AQ2, |tau|<=10^-8, fixed alpha>0, hbar, spacing and E_star. No state identification or deformation.

dictionary.eta: pushforward of the actual centered Wilson spectral measure
dictionary.q: omega_num(W^2), actual unknown second observable moment, |q-1/4|<=1/500
dictionary.v: integral x^2 d eta<=B=36+98|tau|; an upper bound is not equality
dictionary.R: <chi,H_phys^-1 chi>=alpha^-1 integral x^-1 d eta, inverse-energy quadratic form; no static-susceptibility assertion

frozen_certificate_choices.classification: dimensionless proof/certificate choices, not new physical couplings

shared_candidate_patterns: Window minorant (L-x)/(L-a) on x>=a, including an atom at L
Reciprocal upper quadratic [x^2-(2b+a)x+b^2+2ab]/(a b^2), with residual (x-a)(x-b)^2/(a b^2 x)
Preserve baseline support/Cauchy bounds as comparisons, no optimality claim
required: Prove each pointwise bound on the entire continuous half-line, not a grid
Use the correct sign of the x^2 coefficient when substituting only a second-moment ceiling
Propagate the joint unknown q,w relations to exact rational uniform endpoints at the numerical coupling cap
Retain a possible atom at the window endpoint and distinguish a mass lower bound from a hard spectral cutoff
Prove inverse on the reducing vacuum-orthogonal subspace is well defined and has inverse-energy units

Verify abstract measures eta_A=(delta_2+delta_4)/8, eta_B=delta_1/32+3delta_3/16+delta_5/32, eta_C=(1/4)Uniform[3-sqrt(3),3+sqrt(3)] have the same first three moments; compare atomic/atomless type and inverse responses
Keep those controls distinct from the actual AQ Hamiltonian and from actual thermodynamic-state nonuniqueness
Cite Bertsimas-Popescu and the current spectral-bootstrap preprint as method ancestry, not Hruday inventions
sources: Bertsimas and Popescu SIAM J Optim 15 (2005), Sections2-3
Abbott et al arxiv2605.20509v1, SectionsIII.1, IV.1-IV.3 and VII.4
acceptance: Independent complete analytic certificates and exact executed arithmetic/countercontrols, reviewed by the skeptic. Report a limited outcome if a candidate fails. Model-specific application; scientific priority unverified.
claim_exclusions: True AQ spectrum determined by extremal fixtures
Sharp or globally optimal certificate without proof
next: Loop3 remains unselected until AT2 independent outputs and skeptical review. Stop after the third reviewed investigation.
